name: Cimmerian-Dolmen
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, dust seas stretching to the horizon emerge like the bones of the planet.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
